Hey, you! Are you fighting with all your might?\n...No good!! That's not enough to win!\nThen what, you asked? You need to go and win it!!
Hey, it's you! Nice to see you again!! You're so\nfull of spirit! But I'm also pumped, you know!!\nShall we start it again?!
A special annual martial arts competition is being\nheld now. They call it putting your life on the\nline, and the place is here! Just right here!!
What? It's stifling you?! C'mon! You stifled me!\nA battle should be hot! And a battle will only\nstart when things get hot!!
What? Sounds familiar?! Stop being so fussy!!\nNow, let your fighting spirit burn! Heat it up!!
Risk your life and dive into the battle!!\nNever step back, not even a single step!\nControl the battle and be stronger than yesterday!!
Here it comes! I feel you!\nI can see your fighting spirit burning inside\nof you!! It's good!
Now! Fight! Show your fighting spirit!
You give up before challenging?!\nNo! That's bad! Fire up your spirit!\nMore more more! And plunge into the battle!!
Great! Now you are a spark in a brutal fight!!\nFire up your spirit and grab your victory!!
What?! Why not fire up your spirit more?!\nLet your fighting spirit burn!\nNever back down and jump into the battle!!
You turn your back on the decisive battle...?\nHow can you go on an adventure with such a weak\nfighting spirit?! You apathetic adventurer!
